question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Out of the woods
solution:
The correct answer is **"Not in danger."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom** "out of the woods" **means that a dangerous or difficult situation has been overcome or resolved. (किसी खतरनाक या कठिन परिस्थिति पर काबू पा लिया गया है या हल कर लिया गया है)

 
 
• **Example**: *My mother informed me that they were **out of the woods**__ then.*
 
 
 
• It can also refer to being physically removed from a wooded area.
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.

3d:Tbee,

The correct answer is** "helpful."**
